messages.subject: ISA R workshop
parts:
The ISA is planning an R workshop.
We still haven't decided wether to make it begginers-oriented or
advanced.
Being statisticians, we are polling in order to decide. Please share
your opinon at the ISA site.
http://www.statistics.org.il/?p=250
